args.text:
Runs in batch: 8 (r01–r08). Accepted: 8. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
All runs pass the rigid-body invariance and closure checks. All of them report the width-free ratio, so the plane-sections check was not run. Its value is above threshold, as expected when root width changes.
r01 has about 2.1 times the batch centre strain-rate (REGR) peak (111.48 vs 53.15 %/h). Its flank difference is about 2.1 times larger too. Its peak position is the same as the batch (421 µm), and its growth zone (684 µm) and largest flank difference position (284 µm) match r05, at stride 1. Read as a faster-growing root, not a fault.
The large |z| values in the other runs come from the near-zero batch spread. The actual differences are small (for example 0.19 %/h in the REGR peak and 11 µm in growth-zone length).
No flagged runs, so nothing to compare between them.
